artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan: land the width-2 total-edge Tier-2 sliced witness (C36 row + C2 pin), then remove the three recomputation faults in the landed liveness decision procedure (early-exit iteration, hoisted inner fixpoint, position-space leaf cache), each behind an equality lemma and a measurement gate.

memory_candidates.content: In this repository, a certificate-class non-vacuity row in scripts/certificate-witness-inventory.txt is gated by C36b's interest expression, and for a time-sliced certificate that expression (c36Sliced) requires a formula of the claimed clause kind to occur in G.slab t w -- the SLICE LABELLING -- not merely in the closure and not in the certificate's target-path labels. A certificate whose slices label only atoms therefore cannot carry any kind on its row, however rich its closure or its path labels are. Plan-time consequence: before committing to a multi-minute kernel `decide` on a new witness, evaluate the interest expression first (a ~20 s compile) -- it is the cheaper of the two gates and the one more likely to fail.
